decisions.text: Pages 1-8 and 10: images generated with Higgsfield model gpt_image_2_6 (quality high, PNG) through the connected Higgsfield account. Page 9 (Request 5, 2026-11-12): images generated with the Higgsfield API, Marketing Studio Image 2.5 Flare (marketing-studio/image/flare, quality high, 2k, enhance_prompt false), using the canonical character sheets and the layout PNG as ordered references. Character sheets and panels are text-free; lettering is composited by the shared CLI.
decisions.reason: User instruction on 2026-11-10 ('sure') approving Higgsfield; on 2026-11-12 the connected account had 1.25 credits, the user supplied an API key with an API balance ('i’ve $10 + in hf api'), and gpt_image_2_6 is not offered through the API, so Flare (GPT Image 2.5 based) is the closest available model.

ananya.name: Dr. Ananya
ananya.description: Indian woman in her late 30s, clinic owner and doctor. Calm, confident and caring. Teal kurta beneath an open white coat (source). Shoulder-length black hair tied in a low bun with a few loose strands, slim build, small gold stud earrings, a stethoscope worn around her neck (never in use) in every scene where she wears the white coat (manga supplement, from the accepted reference sheet).

traits: Calm almond-shaped eyes with slightly heavy upper lids and a gentle downward outer corner
Soft, straight medium-thick eyebrows set fairly level
Oval face with a defined, slightly pointed chin and a small bindi-free forehead; small nose with a rounded tip
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: Indian female clinic owner, late 30s, calm, confident, caring; teal kurta beneath white coat. Manga supplement: the three face traits, low bun hairstyle and gold studs, chosen to separate her from Meera.

meera.name: Meera

script.style: Full-colour, approachable Indian slice-of-life manga. Clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural daylight, restrained blue and teal accents, simple readable backgrounds. Expressive but natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, numbers, speech bubbles or captions inside the artwork; device screens show only abstract blank blocks and simple icons.
script.continuity: Keep Dr. Ananya, Meera, Ravi, the Nurse, Mr. Raman, Priya, the Pharmacist and the Lab Technician identical to their canonical reference sheets in face traits, hair, build, skin tone and clothing for the whole comic. Device screens never show readable text or real personal data. Page 10 panels 2-3 (10-2, 10-3) are a future vision: soft pale-blue vignette border and lighter, airy palette so they never read as current features.

We'll let you know when your results are ready.' has a tail to 'labtech'. Panel D, bottom left and tall: caption 'Results ready: Ravi is notified.' and a teal label 'Welbuk Health app · email · WhatsApp', with 'ravi'. Panel E, bottom right upper: caption 'Dr. Ananya is notified on Welbuk Care.' and a teal label 'RESULTS READY', with 'ananya'. pages.observation: The image hash matches the earlier request, and the image looks the same. The tall left panel followed by the stacked right column reads normally. It is unclear what 'Meanwhile' is simultaneous with. 'the prescription' assumes a prescribing event that has not been shown, and Ravi never collects the medicine. Ravi does not reply to the lab tech. In Panel F the 'meera' name text runs into the RESULTS READY box. The captions in Panels A and B touch the top border. This page is mostly notifications told through captions, with few reactions. The text is readable.
